name: classify_repo
description: Classify a code repository into a domain, collection, and topics.

domain_index.description: Index into existing_domains list. Use -1 to propose a new domain.

new_domain.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise the proposed new domain name.

new_domain_desc.description: Empty unless domain_index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed domain (what it covers, not the specific repository). Stored alongside the domain row.

collection_index.description: Index of an existing collection within the chosen domain (as shown in the tree). Use -1 to propose a new collection.

new_collection.description: Empty unless collection_index == -1; otherwise the proposed new collection name.

new_collection_desc.description: Empty unless collection_index == -1; otherwise a one-sentence description of the proposed collection (what family of work it groups, not the specific repository). Stored alongside the collection row.

topics.description: Topics naming the repository's salient semantic concepts. Each topic must be distinct from entities, from the chosen domain/collection, and from structural metadata, and should pass the linking/reusability/specificity tests.
